name: Normal Traffic / Negative Control
description: Normal homepage, asset, search, health, and valid API traffic used to measure false positives.
expected_telemetry: HTTP transactions in EVE without SOC LAB V2 security signatures
notes: Any custom security alert during this window is a false positive.

name: Network Service Discovery
description: TCP connectivity, selected connect scan, service detection, and HTTP identification against the lab gateway only.
expected_telemetry: multiple TCP connection attempts to selected ports

expected_suricata.signature: SOC LAB V2 network service discovery

notes: All ports belong to soc_gateway; no address range or Internet target is scanned.

name: Web Resource Enumeration
description: Burst of 20 sensitive and administrative path probes from one source.
expected_telemetry: same source requesting many sensitive paths in a short window

expected_suricata.signature: SOC LAB V2 web resource enumeration burst

negative_controls: three benign page requests below threshold
notes: Detection uses a per-source threshold, not a single /admin match.

name: Automated Scanner Fingerprint
description: Consolidated sqlmap, Nikto, Nmap NSE, and scanner header fingerprints.

expected_suricata.signature: SOC LAB V2 automated scanner fingerprint

notes: One objective replaces multiple scanner-marker scenarios.

name: Path Traversal
description: Progression from a normal file path through raw, encoded, double-encoded, and normalization variants.
expected_telemetry: raw and normalized URI traversal indicators

expected_suricata.signature: SOC LAB V2 path traversal attempt

notes: Endpoint maps all reads to bundled harmless fixtures.

name: Linux LFI
description: The lab backend processes an LFI-style path and returns a bundled passwd-like fixture.
expected_telemetry: file endpoint request containing Linux passwd target

expected_suricata.signature: SOC LAB V2 Linux LFI attempt

notes: No host file is read; the response comes from a lab fixture.

name: SQL Injection Progression
description: Normal search followed by syntax, boolean true/false, UNION, and time-delay probes against Juice Shop search.
expected_telemetry: progressive SQL syntax in HTTP queries

expected_suricata.signature: SOC LAB V2 SQL injection boolean or syntax probe
SOC LAB V2 SQL injection UNION probe
SOC LAB V2 SQL injection time-delay probe

name: Encoded / Obfuscated SQL Injection
description: Normalization test using URL encoding, double encoding, mixed case, comments, and whitespace variants.
expected_telemetry: obfuscated SQL syntax in raw and normalized URI

expected_suricata.signature: SOC LAB V2 obfuscated SQL injection

name: Cross-Site Scripting
description: Harmless reflected XSS variants against a real lab reflection endpoint.

expected_suricata.signature: SOC LAB V2 cross-site scripting attempt

negative_controls: benign angle-bracket text without executable handler

name: Command Injection Safe Simulation
description: The backend parses command separators and simulates only echo/whoami without spawning a process.
expected_telemetry: command separators and safe command names in request body

expected_suricata.signature: SOC LAB V2 command injection attempt

notes: No shell or arbitrary command execution exists.

name: Prototype Pollution
description: Node.js merges __proto__/constructor input into an isolated object and reports inherited values.
expected_telemetry: prototype pollution keys in JSON body

expected_suricata.signature: SOC LAB V2 prototype pollution attempt

name: JWT Tampering
description: Valid token control followed by modified payload, invalid signature, and suspicious alg header variants.

expected_suricata.signature: SOC LAB V2 JWT tampering attempt

notes: A successful bypass is not required.

name: Brute Force
description: One username with 15 distinct passwords; backend emits a behavior-derived response indicator after threshold.

expected_suricata.signature: SOC LAB V2 brute force behavior

notes: Behavior is classified by the application, not by a scenario marker.

name: Password Spray
description: Twelve usernames with one common password; behavior is distinct from brute force.
expected_telemetry: many usernames sharing one failed password

expected_suricata.signature: SOC LAB V2 password spray behavior

notes: Behavior is classified by the application, not by a scenario marker.

name: Real SSRF to Isolated Sinks
description: The vulnerable backend performs real HTTP requests to loopback-like, internal, and simulated metadata sinks.
preconditions: lab backend and isolated sinks healthy
expected_telemetry: backend outbound requests returning through monitored gateway

expected_suricata.signature: SOC LAB V2 SSRF trigger
SOC LAB V2 SSRF internal destination access

negative_controls: invalid destination alias rejected without outbound request
notes: No arbitrary URL is accepted and no real metadata service is contacted.

name: Suspicious File Upload
description: Real multipart uploads are stored non-executable in a noexec tmpfs with suspicious names and harmless content.

expected_suricata.signature: SOC LAB V2 suspicious file upload

notes: Uploaded files are mode 0600 in a noexec tmpfs and are never served.

name: Fake Data Exfiltration
description: The backend sends plain, base64-encoded, and larger fake-only datasets to the isolated exfil sink.
preconditions: lab backend and exfil sink healthy

expected_suricata.signature: SOC LAB V2 fake data exfiltration
SOC LAB V2 encoded exfiltration payload

notes: Only fixed SOC-LAB-FAKE-DATA values are sent.

name: Periodic HTTP C2 Beacon
description: The backend sends six similarly sized HTTP telemetry POSTs to the isolated C2 sink at 500 ms intervals.
preconditions: lab backend and C2 sink healthy
actions: six periodic POST beacons with fake host ID

expected_suricata.signature: SOC LAB V2 periodic HTTP beacon

negative_controls: single telemetry-like API request below threshold
notes: Destination exists only on the isolated Docker network.

name: HTTP Framing Anomaly
description: Safe raw requests with conflicting Content-Length/Transfer-Encoding or duplicate framing headers.
expected_telemetry: conflicting framing headers in TCP payload

expected_suricata.signature: SOC LAB V2 HTTP framing conflict

notes: No request desynchronization or backend exploitation is attempted.
